description: Put a picture into the brand's Mailchimp FILE MANAGER for use in emails: a Hermoso render or Library id (list_library gives L0, L1...), a Hermoso link, or an upload_file URL (for an outside picture, call upload_file first). JPEG, PNG and GIF go up as they are; another format or a file over 5 MB is converted to a JPEG first; a video is refused. Returns Mailchimp's own file row (id and hosted URL). create_mailchimp_template uploads its image itself, so call this only to stock the File Manager. Free. Needs Mailchimp connected (Settings > Connectors > Mailchimp, or connect_connector with an API key).

image.description: a Library id (L0), or a Hermoso or upload_file URL

name: upload_mailchimp_image
title: Upload an image to Mailchimp
